qualityGate.reason: The Playwright test artifact is well-structured, compiles correctly, and uses Playwright APIs appropriately. The test code separates page object logic from tests and uses fixtures for test data, enhancing reusability and maintainability. Selectors are mostly clear and appropriate for the page used. Assertions clearly check visibility states. Minor improvements could be made in selector specificity and adding assertions for element interactivity, but overall this is a solid and executable test artifact.
